reasoning_traces.think:
The Trench Funnel framework synthesizes seven domains—biophysical, cognitive, DFS, environmental, market, matchup, and on-field—into a coherent causal chain. Air density affects ballistics through \Delta d = f(ρ, v_w)·Δt, where ρ is air density and v_w is wind speed. Injury availability modifies snap share via ΔS = g(I_out, I_questionable), reflecting positional depth impacts. Tracking data modulates player efficiency with η = RYOE / Expected RYOE, capturing real-time mechanical performance. These primitives form a layered Bayesian network in GSI, where Kalshi priors are updated using derived environmental and injury factors. In GSE, these inputs drive state transitions in simulated game scripts. The system flags divergence between Kalshi and book lines (>3 pts) as a stale market signal, invalidating Layer 1 priors. Dualities emerge in how environmental and injury data both influence game dynamics but through distinct mechanisms—ballistics versus personnel rotations. Failure modes include unmodeled weather shifts or sudden injury news post-compile, which invalidate assumptions about static conditions.
